name: Extendo Datacenter Belfort
notes: Official Extendo page describes a Belfort data center certified ISO27001 and HDS; DataCenterPlatform lists the 31 Rue Becquerel, 90000 Belfort facility as Tier III+.

name: OPCORE / Scaleway DC5 Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone
notes: Scaleway says DC5 is in Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone and offers more than 20 MW of IT power; DataCenterPlatform lists 25 avenue de l'Eguillette and 24 MW connection capacity.

name: OPCORE DC6 Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone
notes: Official public-consultation register for an environmental authorization describes renovation/rehabilitation of an existing warehouse into the DC6 data center in Saint-Ouen-l'Aumone; consultation ran 2025-12-01 to 2026-03-02.

name: Datacenter public communautaire regional francilien
developer: GIE d'Infogerance Publique Communautaire / Val d'Oise Numerique
notes: Val-d'Oise department describes the public regional/community data-center initiative launched from 2020; the operating site is Lognes in Seine-et-Marne, so this is included as a Val-d'Oise-led project rather than a facility physically in the department.

name: SEGRO Petits Carreaux Bonneuil-sur-Marne data center
notes: DCD reports a public-consultation-stage plan for a 13,800 sqm data-center complex at the Petits Carreaux business park near Bonneuil-sur-Marne with 70 MW IT capacity.

name: Icade Paris Orly-Rungis hyperscale data center
notes: DCD reports Icade plans a EUR280m, 65,000 sqm hyperscale project at Paris Orly-Rungis business park, with eventual 130 MW and target online date around 2029/2030.

name: Goodman former Signify site Villeneuve-Saint-Georges data centers
notes: DCD reports Goodman's plan to convert the former Signify logistics center in Villeneuve-Saint-Georges into two data centers, and says the scheme was granted approval the prior year.

name: OPCORE DC3 / PAR3 Vitry-sur-Seine
notes: Marketplace and directory sources list OPCORE DC3 at 61 Rue Julian Grimau, 94400 Vitry-sur-Seine; DataCenterPlatform gives 12 MW connection capacity.

name: XL360 Toulon data center
notes: XL360 official page lists the Toulon data center; DCD reported its opening/inauguration as the first data center in the Var department.

name: UltraEdge Toulon Bir-Hakeim
notes: UltraEdge official facility page lists Toulon Bir-Hakeim, postal code 83200, in its local data-center network.

name: UltraEdge Avignon TDR
notes: UltraEdge official facility page lists Avignon TDR, postal code 84000, in Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur.

name: ECOBIO-H2 Data Center Avignon
notes: DataCenterMap lists ECOBIO-H2 at LaScierie, 15 Bd Saint-Lazare, Avignon, with 0.1 MW; DCMag reports the green hydrogen/solar-powered urban data center in Avignon.

name: ETIX Vendee #1 La Roche-sur-Yon
notes: ETIX official page lists ETIX Vendee #1 at 4 Imp. Philippe Gozola, 85000 La Roche-sur-Yon, with 240 kW and 80 racks.

name: Microzone Montaigu-Vendee datacenter
notes: Microzone official page describes a local secure data center in Montaigu-Vendee with two separate rooms, generator backup, monitoring, fire protection, and photovoltaic panels.

name: Datacampus Cassin1 Futuroscope
notes: Datacampus official page identifies Cassin1 as its main Futuroscope data center, built/commissioned in 2008 and operated 24/7.

name: Cogent Data Center Poitiers
notes: Cogent official locations list includes Poitiers; DataCenterMap lists the Poitiers facility at 18/22 rue Jeanne d'Arc and reports 0.25 MW.

name: EXA Infrastructure Poitiers
notes: Inflect lists EXA Infrastructure Poitiers as a data center at Zone d'Amenagement Concerte de Saint-Eloi, Poitiers, offering colocation and connectivity.

name: SAM Informatique Neufchateau datacenter
notes: SAM's official Neufchateau office page lists datacenter and cloud services; earlier public social post announced the first Vosges data center at Neufchateau. Capacity not published.

name: VirtuaCenter Auxerre
notes: Virtua-Networks official page says VirtuaCenter is its own data center in central Auxerre with total capacity of 900 sqm; DataCenterMap also lists VirtuaCenter in Auxerre.
